name: moatwatcher
prompt: A lone cloaked figure stands on a dark stone castle wall at night holding a small glowing lantern and watching over a glowing teal moat below. The water ripples gently and softly reflects the light, faint mist drifts slowly over the moat, the lantern flame flickers. Very slow, subtle camera push-in. Painterly, cinematic, quiet ambient night sound, no speech.
